title: The runner runs out of turns while it waits
what: The runner runs out of turns while it waits on a paid run, so the front reads the results itself.
why: The work is lost and the front spends its own context reading results the runner should report.
failing_case: the runner ran out of turns while waiting on a paid run three times on 22 Oct (measure, live6, full run); the front read the results itself; should finish and report within its turns (handover, three notes)
